$comment: Read by `yarn i18n:translate` and by anyone translating by hand. `untranslated` terms stay exactly as written (case may follow the language's rules where noted). `fixed` terms always use the given translation. `style` is per-locale guidance.

untranslated.Electron Fiddle: Product name. Never translate or shorten.
untranslated.fiddle: A small Electron project that this app edits and runs. Keep the English word. German: "Fiddle" (neuter, das Fiddle, plural Fiddles). Japanese: "Fiddle".
untranslated.gist: A GitHub Gist. Keep the English word. German: "Gist" (der Gist, plural Gists). Japanese: "Gist".
untranslated.Electron Forge: Product name. "Forge" on its own also stays.
untranslated.API names and code: Code identifiers (BrowserWindow, ipcMain, app.whenReady(), process.versions), file names (main.js, preload.js, renderer.js, index.html, package.json), command-line flags, environment variables, URLs and keyboard shortcuts stay exactly as written.
untranslated.Placeholders: {{name}} placeholders and $t(...) references stay exactly as written, including their names. They may move within the sentence.

Make (Forge command).ja: インストーラーを作成

Preload script.ja: プリロードスクリプト

Stable / Beta / Nightly (release channel.ja: 安定版 / ベータ版 / ナイトリー

Keyboard shortcut.ja: キーボードショートカット

style.*: Sentence case where the language has case. Keep the ellipsis character (…) on labels that open a dialog. Keep it short: buttons and menu items must fit their maxLength. Don't add trailing punctuation to labels, buttons or menu items.
style.de: Informal "du", as in GitHub's German UI. Use imperatives for buttons and menu items ("Speichern", "Datei öffnen …"). Put a space before the ellipsis ("Öffnen …"). Use German quotation marks („…“).
style.ja: Polite です／ます form for sentences; noun or verb phrases without です for buttons, menu items and titles. Full-width punctuation (、。「」). No 。 at the end of labels or buttons. Put a space between Latin words and Japanese text only where it aids readability (e.g. "Electron のバージョン").
